lines: Ankit Fatehpuria, an Individual Selling Shareholder, is selling 2,286,052 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹34.52 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares face a 6-month lock-in from allotment, so further value may be realised after that period.
Pre-offer holding and gain are unknown, as the documents do not confirm them.
